reason: I don't trust a new vendor with my code and session data — running tusharmewara/loom as a local daemon that touches every agent's credentials and sessions is too much surface area for $30/seat/month, and as a deal hunter I'd rather stay on free tiers than pay a vendor I haven't vetted.
objection: I don't trust a new vendor with my code and session data.
would_change_my_mind: a credible third-party security audit confirming the daemon is local-only and never sends code, sessions, or credentials to the vendor.
